patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient reports experiencing fever, chills, and a headache three days after undergoing an open cholecystectomy. She also had an episode of hypotension post-operation that was resolved with IV fluids. Additionally, she had an abdominal hysterectomy 16 years ago.

Secondary_Symptoms: Right-sided chest pain that increases on inspiration

patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Underwent abdominal hysterectomy 16 years ago for multiple fibroids of the uterus. She has a 17-year history of smoking one pack of cigarettes daily.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: History of smoking one pack of cigarettes daily for 17 years.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: Reports discomfort. No other abnormalities noted apart from the symptoms related to her recent surgery and current complaints.

objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with fever, chills, headache, right-sided chest pain, and a productive cough following an abdominal surgery.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Doctor, three days after my open cholecystectomy I developed fever and chills with a bad headache. I also have right-sided chest pain that gets worse when I take a deep breath, and I’ve had a productive cough for the past 12 hours.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any swelling in your joints?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any swelling in my joints or any joint pain.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual growths on your scalp?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual growths on my scalp.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching lately?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t had any itching lately.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any trouble raising your arms above your head?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, yes—I can raise my arms above my head, though I feel a bit uncomfortable because of the right-sided chest pain when I move or take a deep breath.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any loss of vision that isn’t accompanied by pain?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t had any loss of vision, and nothing like that has happened without pain.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had a fever that’s been so high it feels like you’re burning up—something above 104°F (40°C) that makes you feel extremely hot or dizzy?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t measured it, but I do have fever with chills and I feel extremely hot and dizzy at times—about three days after the cholecystectomy.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling unusually stressed or overwhelmed lately?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t been unusually stressed or overwhelmed—mostly it’s the fever with chills, the headache, and the right-sided chest pain that hurts more when I take a deep breath that’s worrying me.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you experienced any burning or discomfort when you urinate?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any burning or discomfort when I urinate.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a lump in your breast that feels firm and hasn’t moved?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t noticed any firm lumps in my breast, and nothing there feels unusual or hasn’t moved.”
